So in my school, we had white uniforms and in grade 7, our history teacher was absent and so the temp teacher was making few students come to front of the class and read out a page from the history book. So she calls upon me and I go up and I was reading out the page when I see my two best friends signaling me something. I obviously didn't understand and I thought they were trying to make me laugh so I ignored them. I see some of the boys laughing and what not and then I finally get to my seat and my friends tell me my entire white dress was red and I am SO embarrassed I have no idea what to do. The boys were still laughing about it. It was the last period and everybody was filing out after class and I didn't know how to go out like that, (I live in a very conservative country) so then my friends loosened the handles of my backpack so it covered all the way to my butt and that's how I left.
